api.plan_kernel: (batch: 'int' = 16, m: 'int' = 4032, n: 'int' = 4032, d: 'int' = 72, mb: 'int' = 32, bc: 'int' = 256, cores_max: 'int' = 30) -> 'dict'

assumptions: h_reduce_max/h_reduce_sum(axis=1) on a (MB,16) tile yields a (MB,) row tensor
Tensor.reshape((n1,MB,16)) is a metadata view of the same flat UB buffer
masked vector_dup(repeat_times=n1, blk_stride=1, rep_stride=2*MB=64) writes one 16-value NZ row slot per group; 64 is inside the 8-bit immediate
Scalar.set_as(<UB element>) is a legal UB-to-scalar load
h_reduce_sum on Float compiles to Float vcadd; h_max to Float vmax
the 16-group Half fold is emitted as explicit vec_max calls, because the high-level h_max rejected the inferred step of a sliced NZ tensor in Round99
the Half shift estimate uses Half vcmax (Float vcmax is unsupported here)
vector_dup(mask,dst,scalar,1,1,1) with an explicit repeat slice fills exactly one repeat

a 32-lane vector_dup tail mask is legal for both row dtypes an MB=32 row can need: 32 Float = 128 B (half of one 64-lane Float repeat) and 32 Half = 64 B (one quarter of a 128-lane Half repeat), both 32 B aligned; this design only fills Float rows (row_prev/row_zero/denominator) while Half rows come from h_reduce_max and h_cast
in-place same-shape h_sub/h_mul/h_add/h_exp with dst==src0 is supported
a Float UB buffer can be reused sequentially (score->exp->low residual, Half score->P_hi, row expansion->widened P_hi) without an explicit alias API

h_cast of -FLT_MAX to Half saturates rather than producing NaN; the phantom mask is still correct if it saturates to -inf, because every real scaled score is above -16384 so max() selects a real value
a dynamic if_scope (no else_scope) around only vector_dup phantom fills does not re-trigger the Round99 high-level if/else canonicalisation crash
a 32 KiB single tensor_mov L0C->UB burst is legal (Round85 executed a 64 KiB single burst of the same form)
the 16-group Float denominator fold is emitted as pairwise vec_add stages on flat operands, so its association differs from Round101's 8-group fold and from Round99's 4-group fold

a masked data_move with burst=256 32 B units (8192 B) is legal; the CANN DMA burst immediate is far larger than 128, but the ROOT must confirm this on the real compiler -- this builder does not shrink it to a previously proven 128
the Cube accepts m=32, k=80, n=256 for QK and m=32, k=256, n=80 for P@V: L0A needs 5120 B and 16384 B, L0B needs 40960 B and 40960 B, both inside 64 KiB
experiment: MB=32 x BC=256 single-launch streaming vision flash attention

host_protocol.formula: max|scaled QK| <= 16384, measured finitely by the caller or bounded by sqrt(d) * max|q| * max|k|

denominator_fold.order: a=g0+g1; then for left=2,4,...,14: b=g[left]+g[left+1]; a=a+b. 15 explicit vec_add calls on flat operands

phantom_key_mask.why: zero-padded K rows make the phantom scores exactly 0; exp(0 - shift) would add 1.0 to every denominator row

math.row_broadcast: explicit per-row vector_dup expansion (no implicit broadcast); the Half-representable shift uses the exact native uint16 copy + Half transpose path

shift_fold.order: a=max(g0,g1); then for left=2,4,...,14: b=max(g[left],g[left+1]); a=max(a,b). max is exact under any association

purpose: halve the per-row Float row-broadcast and cumulative O/L update count versus Round101 MB=64 x BC=128, at the explicit cost of roughly doubling K/V reload traffic; the net effect is NOT assumed
